name: Dragon Flag
cues: Lie on a bench and grip the edge behind your head
Lift your body until only your upper back touches the bench
Keep a straight line from shoulders to feet
Lower slowly without bending at the hips

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Hip and lumbar flexion are 0 throughout, so the shoulders-to-feet line stays straight, pivoting on the upper back, with hands closed on the pad end behind the head (z -0.37). The body line only rises to 55 deg (feet 1.78 m at the top). Dragon flags are usually shown lowering from near vertical (~75-90 deg). The top angle is the author's own judgment, so the owner should check it.
